subject: Commit shift request: sprint capacity window for Nimbus deal
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hart <sara.hart@oemtech.com>, Cloud Sales <cloudsales@megacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commit shift request: sprint capacity window for Nimbus deal

Hi Sara / Mega Cloud team —

Quick context: NimbusAI (see HS-76421) is pacing toward a Q4 go-live and the deal is contingent on dedicated pool availability. We previously discussed a 480-GPU committed pool. As we lock the term sheet this week, procurement has flagged an upstream lead-time risk on OEM delivery that would push the initial fleet availability past our target SLA for the product launch.

What we need from you both:
- OEM (Sara): earliest binding ETA for full 480-GPU order and whether you can split the shipment so we receive an initial tranche earlier (we're proposing ~60% / 40% split). If you can accelerate any portion, please call out: minimum tranche size, incremental expedite fees, and shipping SLA.
- Mega Cloud: short-term reserved capacity as a backstop for the first 60–90 days — specifically 120 GPUs available on activation within 7 days while OEM fulfillment completes. Please provide a 90-day reserved pricing delta and any activation logistics.

Attachments: initial quote attached (NIM_OEM_Quote_draft.pdf).

Timeline ask: can you provide written confirmation of the options above by EOD 2025-06-17 so we can finalize the DocuSign slot commitment?

Thanks — simple next steps appreciated.

Dylan Brooks
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Hart <sara.hart@oemtech.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Cloud Sales <cloudsales@megacloud.com>
Date: 2025-06-16T02:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit shift request: sprint capacity window for Nimbus deal

Dylan —

Thanks for the heads up and the quote. Short answer: there is room to create an early tranche but there are constraints in the current production queue. Current profile:
- Standard lead time for a full 480-unit build: ~18 weeks from release to line.
- We can prioritize an early tranche and accelerate the first shipment to ~12 weeks from release, provided we receive a committed minimum tranche and expedite fee.

Options we can offer now:
1) Accelerated tranche (preferred): 60% of order (288 GPUs) shipped at 12-week lead time. Minimum tranche = 40 GPUs. Expedited fee = 8% on top of the unit price to cover rush routing and overtime.
2) Pilot ship: 10–20 units in 6–8 weeks (subject to final component checks) for validation/testing only — not production capacity.
3) Full build at standard cadence: 18 weeks, no expedite fee.

I've attached the latest schedule (production_schedule_eta.xlsx) showing available line windows and component dependencies. If you confirm the tranche size and agree to the expedite terms, we can lock the 12-week slot. Note that if we commit to a tranche <40 units we will not be able to prioritize on the accelerated line.

Let me know the final split (or if you want me to hold two adjacent line windows pending DocuSign). Happy to set a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Sara Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts — OEM Tech
Attachments: production_schedule_eta.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit shift request: sprint capacity window for Nimbus deal

Quick internal take —

If we accept Sara's accelerated tranche (12-week) with the 8% expedite fee, it materially increases first-month COGS but buys us the launch SLA. My recommendation: absorb the premium for the first tranche to protect net retention and go-to-market momentum; we can rebalance later in the contract price ladder.

Short ask to Cloud Sales: can Mega Cloud provide 90-day reserved capacity for 120 GPUs at an activation window <=7 days? If so, what's the cost delta (daily burn / reserved fee)? Please attach the reserved quote (MegaCloud_reserved_quote_NIM-123.pdf) and call out any cancellation penalties.

Action items:
- Dylan: if you agree, sign the slot commitment (DocuSign link) for 60/40 split and expedited terms.
- Laura / Vivek: scope accounting impact; we may need a one-time credit or revised ARR ramp.
- Karthik: confirm whether ops can absorb staggered arrival (KV cache priming, staging pools).

Ben
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hart <sara.hart@oemtech.com>, Cloud Sales <cloudsales@megacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-16T18:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commit shift request: sprint capacity window for Nimbus deal

Sara — thanks for the clear options. Quoting your note: "we can prioritize an early tranche and accelerate the first shipment to ~12 weeks from release" and "minimum tranche = 40 GPUs". That aligns with our needs but we need written confirmation on two points before we execute:

1) Split delivery: Redwood will accept a 60/40 split (288 early / 192 later) contingent on the 12-week window for the 60% tranche. Please confirm you can reserve those two line windows and the specific ship weeks (week numbers) in writing.
2) Expedite terms: we agree to the 8% expedite fee for the first tranche. Please confirm whether that fee is applied to the first tranche only or the full PO. Also confirm responsibility for customs/expedited freight.

Mega Cloud / Cloud Sales — please provide the 90-day reserved activation quote for 120 GPUs (activation <=7 days). If reserved is not doable, can you confirm immediate spot access + guaranteed capacity within 72 hours? We need a short-term backstop while OEM fulfillment completes.

I've opened the DocuSign slot commitment for the tranche split + expedite terms: https://www.docusign.com/link/NIM-2025-211. Please confirm acceptance by EOD 2025-06-17 so we can finalize the procurement path with procurement ops (Procurement Ops <procure@nimbus-ai.com> is waiting on our confirmation).

If we can't get written confirmation by the deadline we will move to the cloud backfill approach and adjust the quote.

Thanks — appreciate quick confirmations.

Dylan Brooks
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: DocuSign_NIM-2025-211_Slot_Commitment.link, MegaCloud_reserved_quote_NIM-123.pdf
